onboard.title: Welcome to LLM Usage Widget
onboard.desc: Three steps to see your LLM plan usage & balance in real time:
onboard.step1: Click a vendor in the list below to open its config page
onboard.step2: Paste the platform's API key and save (takes effect immediately)
onboard.step3: Back on the desktop, the widget shows real usage; hover the top for toolbar buttons

import.title: Import from CC Switch
import.empty: No keyed configs found in the database
import.hint: Only official-platform keys can be imported; relays (new-api etc.) are not supported and marked as unrecognized.

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.desc: Click a vendor to configure it. Saving takes effect immediately; saved configs are loaded on every start.
vendors.vendorsHint: Same-id definitions in the user folder override built-in presets · v{{version}} · encryption {{enc}}
vendors.vendorInfo: Vendor info (from preset definition; override via the definitions folder)
vendors.logoHint: Images are stored by vendor id under userData/logos and apply everywhere; without one, brand color + initial is used.

editor.title: Vendor Editor
editor.name: Name
editor.label: Window label
editor.testKey: Test API key (local only, never saved)
editor.responseTree: Response JSON (click a leaf to fill the selected target)
editor.pickActive: Picking active: click a leaf in the JSON tree to fill it in
editor.pickIdle: Click ⌖ next to a field, then click a JSON leaf to fill the path
editor.saveHint: Saved to userData/vendors/<id>.toml with hot reload; same id as a built-in overrides it. Saving requires a passing test.

display.title: Display
display.desc: Text and icons always stay fully opaque; opacity applies to the card background only, for a floating look.
display.themesHint: User themes: drop *.css into the themes folder and override variables with body[data-theme='filename']; hot-reloads on save. Glass enables native OS blur on macOS/Win11.
display.fontColorHint: Applies to widget text and icons; secondary text derives at 62% opacity.
display.carouselHint: One card at a time, configured vendors only
display.listHint: All configured vendors in one view
display.bgNone: (no background — text and icons float on the desktop)
display.pollInterval: Poll interval: {{sec}}s (balance vendors fixed at 5 min)
display.pollIntervalMin: Poll interval: {{min}} min (balance vendors fixed at 5 min)

alertsPage.title: Alerts
alertsPage.desc: When usage crosses a threshold: progress bar changes color → widget bubble (click to open settings) → system notification; no repeat until recovery within the same cycle.
alertsPage.balanceMin: Balance minimum (alert below this, in the vendor's currency): {{min}}
alertsPage.overridesHint: Leave blank / unchecked = use the global defaults above; balance minimum is in the vendor's currency.

about.tagline: A floating gauge for LLM usage on your desktop.
about.author: Author
about.privacy: Queries official vendor APIs only; keys are stored locally and encrypted; zero telemetry.

updater.downloaded: Update v{{version}} is ready — takes effect after restart
updater.devOnly: Running in dev mode — update checks disabled
